design: Retrospective EMA machine-cost ranking: first three timed extractions calibrate costs, four later repetitions evaluate sum of extraction components. Nine already complete inventories, budgets1/2/5/9; compare cost order, name order and 128 seeded random orders; all resolve16 questions per inventory. Planning, route parsing, network and human review outside this cost. Separate from prospective equal-field protocol.
prior_information: First source/planning cost run known; quantity ranking outcomes and all inventory availabilities known. This cost-aware experiment is retrospective.
